_comment: Copy to .mcp.json (gitignored) and replace the <...> placeholders. PERL_ROOT is the portable Strawberry Perl root; PERL_HOME is derived by scripts/profile.ps1 as its perl\ subdirectory. MCP_POWERSHELL_PROFILE must point at this checkout's scripts/profile.ps1. CDXSCI_ROOT belongs in scripts/local.psd1 or this env block. Keep .codex/config.toml and .grok/config.toml in agreement by hand. tool_timeout_sec 29400 is the gauntlet WaitTimeoutSeconds (28800) plus 600 s drainage; Codex default is 60 s and Grok default is 6000 s — both are too short without this field (Grok honors it on [mcp_servers.pwsh_exec] in .grok/config.toml / .codex/config.toml).
